description:
Open a project in the R3 editor the user has open in their browser (their most recently used R3 tab) and focus it, so they see it. A project already open there is just focused (never reloaded). Use it to show the user the project you are working on, or before r3_editor_inspect.

The same access rules as opening it by hand: the user's own projects, their teams', and public ones. The editor holds up to 4 projects; at that limit it refuses. Nothing is saved or changed. When no editor is open, the answer says where the user can open one.

projectId.description: The project to open, from r3_project_list or r3_project_create.

name: r3_editor_open

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Show a project in the user's open R3 editor
